testName: Product Catalog Filtering, Attribute Variants & Volume Tiered Pricing
steps:
1. In B2B Storefront, search for "Hydraulic Pump" in search bar
2. In left facet filters, select Manufacturer "AeroFluid" and Rating "Heavy Duty"
3. Click on product "AeroFluid HP-500 Pump"
4. On Product Detail Page (PDP), select Attribute Variant "Size: 2-Inch Bore"
5. Notice Base Unit Price is $450.00
6. Change Quantity from 1 to 25 units
7. Verify price recalculates dynamically to $380.00 reflecting wholesale Tier 2 Pricebook pricing
8. Verify "In Stock - Ships in 24 Hours" availability badge renders
